description: This horizontal bar chart is great for comparing two categories of data in a compact format by overlapping the bars. A common use for this visual is comparing a series of actual data to target/goal data, such as actual financial results to budgeted financial results. Its clean simplicity lends itself to a wide range of uses across disciplines. It is fully customizable including: 1. Bar width 2. Bar transparency 3. Axis 4. Labels and more This visual was created by Acorn Hill. Please view our full listing of Power BI visuals and other consulting services at: https://www.acornhillconsulting.com
